BRINDLE HARBOUR AUTHORITY - IT NOTICE
Subject: Segmentation of yard and quay devices
From: Sam Okoye, IT Infrastructure Manager

From the autumn, every device on the yard and quay networks moves to a new segmented network.
Devices not registered with IT by then will lose network access until an exception is approved.
Exception requests need: device type, location, ports and destinations, data volumes, and an owner.

Registered so far: CCTV, gate controllers, crane telemetry.
Not registered: (none recorded for drone docks)
